records.name: Meta-Psychology
records.publisher: Linnaeus University Press; owned by the journal's editorial board
records.scope_notes: Psychology-focused metascience: systematic reviews, meta-analyses, replication and reproducibility reports, statistical methods, tutorials and research software. A contribution to psychological science is necessary. Existing-data and methodological work fits. Instructions require an OSF project containing applicable data, code and materials, with public sharing and statistical reproducibility checks.

route.conditions: The journal describes itself as completely free and explicitly excludes publication fees. This is an unconditional journal policy, not an affiliation-based waiver. Authors perform manuscript formatting because copyediting is limited; new-submission handling pauses during July.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated; author formatting and required research-material preparation are responsibilities rather than journal charges.

fee_evidence.note: Journal-wide completely-free diamond policy and explicit no-publication-fee statement cover the author route; no waiver or institutional eligibility is required.
Current submission checklist inspected for author obligations and additional charges; specifies OSF research materials and a July processing pause.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty judgment established by the expansion pass; free publication and reproducibility policies do not establish acceptance odds.

records.name: LIBER Quarterly: The Journal of the Association of European Research Libraries
records.publisher: LIBER, the Association of European Research Libraries; supported by Openjournals
records.scope_notes: Research-library and information-science work connecting scholarship and library practice. Scholarly communication, open science, research infrastructure and evidence syntheses can fit when relevant to research libraries; a generic scientometric analysis without that connection is not an assumed fit. Research articles and critical reviews are accepted. Commentary/opinion may receive editorial review only.

route.conditions: Journal-specific instructions exclude APCs and say LIBER covers publication costs. This establishes no publication fee, but no separate explicit submission-fee statement was located. Preserve the candidate diamond route without certifying zero total cost until that point is checked.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Publication costs are covered; submission and any other compulsory charges require explicit confirmation.

fee_evidence.note: Author instructions explicitly exclude APCs and place publication costs with LIBER; submission-fee confirmation remains incomplete.
Current OA policy confirms immediate open access without APCs; it does not separately address submission fees.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty judgment established by the expansion pass; no acceptance probability is inferred from missing statistics.

records.name: Engaging Science, Technology, and Society
records.publisher: Society for Social Studies of Science (4S)
records.scope_notes: Science and Technology Studies, including research cultures, knowledge production, research institutions, openness and relations between science and society. Existing-document and empirical analyses can fit when conceptually grounded and relevant to a broad STS readership. This is not a general statistics or synthesis-methods journal. The individual research-article route is externally peer reviewed; other genres require their own review checks.

route.conditions: The current journal OA policy explicitly excludes submission fees and APCs for contributors. No required society membership or affiliation condition is stated. Follow genre-specific author instructions and data, ethics and generative-AI policies.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated for the ordinary research-article route.

fee_evidence.note: Official OA policy excludes both submission fees and APCs and provides immediate reader access without a waiver condition.
Journal FAQ independently repeats the absence of submission and processing fees.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty judgment established by the expansion pass; broad disciplinary scope does not establish acceptance odds.

records.name: Science Editing
records.publisher: Korean Council of Science Editors; official journal also of the Korean Association of Medical Journal Editors and the Council of Asian Science Editors
records.scope_notes: Scholarly editing and publishing: peer review, reporting, integrity, journal evaluation, publication data mining, bibliometrics, scientometrics, publishing technology and open access. Existing-record analyses and systematic reviews about editing/publishing fit; its medical connections do not require clinical practice or new patient research. Unsolicited articles undergo peer review; commissioned content can receive editorial-board review.

route.conditions: Current author instructions explicitly exclude page charges, APCs and submission fees, and permit researchers worldwide to submit suitable work. The best-practice policy describes the journal as platinum OA without author-side fees. No membership or institutional agreement requirement is stated.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None; page charges are explicitly excluded.

fee_evidence.note: Live section 8 excludes submission, page and processing charges; author qualifications allow researchers worldwide. Page fetched directly after browser-tool HTTP 403.
Live Author Fees section confirms no submission, page or processing charges and no author-side fees; direct fetch succeeded despite browser-tool HTTP 403.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty judgment established by the expansion pass; eligibility to submit worldwide is not a statement about acceptance odds.

records.name: European Science Editing
records.publisher: European Association of Science Editors (EASE), on the ARPHA platform
records.scope_notes: Scholarly publishing and editing, including research integrity, peer review, bibliometrics, open science, statistics and predatory publishing. Existing-data investigations and reviews fit when useful to editors and publishing practice. Original articles are prioritized. Original articles and reviews have a 4,000-word body limit; original articles receive at least two independent expert reviews.

route.conditions: Current journal instructions explicitly exclude submission and publication fees and describe diamond OA. No required EASE membership, affiliation or selective waiver is stated. Paid tailored publicity is optional; adhere to the applicable article-type limits.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated; optional paid publicity is not required for publication.

fee_evidence.note: Official journal submission page directs authors to ARPHA and explicitly excludes submission and publication fees.
Current ARPHA instructions confirm no author fees and identify publicity as optional paid service; direct fetch succeeded after browser-tool HTTP 403.

difficulty.basis: The instructions report an approximate acceptance figure without a defined period or denominator. No comparable acceptance metric or difficulty band is inferred.

notes: Five additional journals, with no venue duplicated from discovery/meta-research.json. Four are verified_free; LIBER Quarterly remains needs_verification because explicit submission-fee confirmation was not found. No repository or preprint records were added.

Current official journal pages were inspected. Science Editing and European Science Editing ARPHA pages returned HTTP 403 in the browser tool but were retrieved successfully by direct HTTP requests and read as live policy pages; those evidence entries are correctly marked page rather than search_snippet.

Scope fits are bounded: Meta-Psychology requires a psychological-science contribution; LIBER Quarterly requires research-library relevance; ESTS requires a broad STS contribution; both editing journals require relevance to scholarly publishing/editing. None is treated as a general-purpose home for every meta-analysis or computational method.

Excluded expansion lead: Journal of Librarianship and Scholarly Communication, https://www.iastatedigitalpress.com/jlsc/site/about/. The current official policy page was blocked or challenge-only, so old primary statements and third-party no-APC listings were not used to certify its current total author cost.

Excluded expansion lead: Information Research, https://publicera.kb.se/ir/instructions. A current official indexed page states no publication fees, but direct access was challenge-protected and a current explicit submission-fee statement was not established. The legacy https://informationr.net/ir/about.html says no submission/publication charges but also discusses optional paid HTML conversion; it was not treated as sufficient proof of the present platform's full fee policy.

Research Synthesis Methods is already in discovery and now has a paid Cambridge OA route with conditional support. Quantitative Science Studies' older society subsidy/waiver notices do not establish an unconditional currently free route; neither was added here.

European Science Editing's live instructions include an approximate acceptance statement but no defined reporting period or submission denominator, so metrics remain empty. All difficulty bands remain unknown. No impact factor, citation level or absent statistic was used to infer acceptance probability.
Independent agent expansion is neither human scientific review nor a venue endorsement. Policies were checked on 2026-11-16 and should be checked again near submission.
